sendSchedule.title: Send the schedule to the customer
sendSchedule.description: The customer picks a day and time by tapping options in the chat, without the AI and without using credits. The booking goes to {bookings}.
sendSchedule.calendly: Services linked to Calendly are booked in Calendly.
sendSchedule.google: Bookings are copied to the Google Calendar of whoever attends.
sendSchedule.sent: Schedule sent. When the customer picks, the booking shows up in the chat.
sendSchedule.windowClosed: More than 24 hours since the customer's last message: WhatsApp only allows templates.
sendSchedule.bookingsOff: Turn on bookings in the business settings to send the schedule.
sendSchedule.noSlots: No free times in the next few days for this selection.

flowStep.help: The customer picks a day and time by tapping options, without the AI and without using credits. Services linked to Calendly are booked in Calendly; the rest in your schedule (and in the Google Calendar of whoever attends, when connected).
flowStep.link: If the Calendly link was sent → go to

calendlyManual.email: To book this service in Calendly the contact needs an email. Add it to the contact and try again.
calendlyManual.slot: That time isn't free in Calendly. Pick another one.
calendlyManual.plan: Your Calendly plan doesn't allow booking from Whasalia: the booking was saved here only.
calendlyManual.reschedule: Calendly bookings can't be moved from here. Cancel it and create a new one.

reply.gone: That booking is no longer active. Message us if you want to book again.
reply.confirmed: Thanks for confirming! See you then.
reply.changeHuman: Sure, someone from the team will help you change the date shortly.

error.no_credits: Not enough credits: reminders cost 1 credit.
error.no_channel: The contact has no connected channel to message.
error.window_closed: More than 24 hours since the customer's last message and this channel doesn't support templates.
error.template_missing: More than 24 hours since the customer's last message and the reminder template isn't created in Meta yet.
error.template_pending: More than 24 hours since the customer's last message and Meta is still reviewing the reminder template.
error.template_rejected: More than 24 hours since the customer's last message and Meta rejected the reminder template.

page.title: {bookings} reminders
page.description: Sent on their own before every {booking} (confirmed or pending) with two buttons: “I confirm”, which marks attendance as confirmed, and “Change date”, which shows the customer the free times to pick another; once picked, the previous time is cancelled on its own.
page.kindHelp: When booked at short notice, only the closest reminder goes out.

template.title: WhatsApp template
template.description: WhatsApp only allows free text if the customer wrote in the last 24 hours. Otherwise the reminder goes out with this Meta-approved template (with the same two buttons). Whasalia creates it and sends it for review on its own.

status.none: Will be created in a few minutes
status.Draft: Couldn't be sent to Meta; retried daily

template.noWhatsapp: Connect a WhatsApp number so the template can be created.

page.readOnly: Only admins can change the reminders.
